description: One developer's machine: the offline scripted model or a live profile may serve, the store is the local SQLite file (or a Postgres the developer points at), and no key is required beyond what the selected model profile itself demands. Dual control is off: acceptance and promotion complete on one recorded decision, as they did before round 18. The profile every test and eval in this repo runs under unless it opts in to another by name.
label: Local — the developer default
name: local
